text: A deep, heavy surge of weight gathering and lurching forward, like something huge starting to charge.
A huge mass heaving into motion: a deep, powerful thrust of weight that bursts forward.
A low, forceful whump of great weight shifting and launching ahead, heavy and fast.
A driving, powerful rumble of heavy mass moving fast, steady and forceful, even in volume throughout.
The continuous deep roar of something enormous rolling quickly over the ground, strong and constant.
A heavy, fast, thundering rumble that keeps pushing forward, low and steady.
A warm, gentle swell of soft light, like a slow breath in.
Soft living warmth rising gently around someone, a calm and tender bloom of energy.
A slow, soothing wave of warm energy, like a peaceful breath filling the air.
A soft, warm glow of living energy pulsing slowly and calmly, like quiet breathing.
A gentle, soothing pulse of healing warmth, soft and slow, even in volume throughout.
A calm bed of soft living energy, breathing slowly in and out, warm and quiet.
A thin, tense shimmer of brittle energy trembling faintly, steady and quiet.
Fragile energy quivering in the air: a fine, nervous, glassy tremble, low in volume and constant.
A faint, strained shiver of power, delicate and tight, holding steady.
A light, fast vibration in the air, quick and energetic, steady underneath everything.
A rapid, airy flutter of energy, buzzing lightly and constantly, even in volume throughout.
Quick, thrumming energy humming fast around someone, light and lively.
